headings.usage: Headers, primary layout titles. Must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.

body.usage: Standard UI text, form labels, descriptions.

data_and_code.usage: Tag names, node IDs, metric values, serial channel output, data tables, sampling rates. MUST use tabular-nums class.

layouts.general: High-density Grid Protocol (Bento Mode B). Utilize h-full to stretch items. Minimal negative space between functional panels. Start with a responsive mobile-first approach, scaling to grid-cols-12 on large screens.
layouts.dashboard_structure: 4-quadrant or multi-pane layout: Left rail for Server/Tag browsing, Top for KPIs, Center for Runtime Dashboard (trends), Bottom/Right for Serial Monitor.
layouts.spacing: Tight padding (p-4 to p-6) within panels to maximize data density. Use standard Tailwind gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between cards.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Grid Borders (Technical Look). Use border-collapse style layouts or subtle 1px border-white/10 on panels. Do not rely on heavy drop shadows in this dark theme.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid. NEVER use glassmorphism for data-heavy panels to prevent visual refraction. Use flat muted grays with sharp or max 4px radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md). No completely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.serial_monitor: Retro-Futurism terminal look. Deep black background (#000000), monospace font, subtle cyan text for active data frames, optional subtle scanline CSS pattern.

components.server_manager: Shadcn datatable or list component with inline status indicators (connected/disconnected).
components.tag_browser: Hierarchical tree view or multi-level list for Node IDs. Include Shadcn Checkboxes for selection and inputs for sampling interval.
components.stats_header: Cardless metric blocks. Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]). Large data values.
components.charts: Sparklines inside datatable rows or compact Shadcn/Recharts line charts. Keep charts muted, using primary color only for the trend line itself.
components.mode_toggle: Prominent Shadcn Switch, Tabs, or segmented control in the top navigation bar to switch between 'Configuration' and 'Runtime' modes.
components.serial_channel_monitor: Terminal-like panel. Include toggle for JSON/MessagePack, start/stop button, and auto-scrolling log view for WebSocket data.

animations.micro_interactions: Subtle -translate-y-[1px] and border brightness increase on hover for interactive elements.
animations.data_updates: Do not animate rapid data changes (causes layout thrashing). Rely on tabular-nums.
animations.serial_stream: Smooth DOM appending for the terminal. Avoid full re-renders for high-speed WebSocket messages to maintain performance.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text secondary on dark background must be #A1A1AA or brighter.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, forms, server list items, and tags MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-server-button', data-testid='mode-toggle', data-testid='tag-list-item').

image_urls.description: Moody blue circuit board. Use sparingly with high opacity overlay (e.g., bg-zinc-950/90) behind the top navbar or as a subtle empty-state illustration for the Server Manager.

universal_guidelines: Design an industrial SCADA-style dark dashboard. It must feel like a command center: high performance, serious, and precise.
Adhere to ISA-101 high-performance HMI principles: keep the normal state visually quiet/muted (dark grays), and reserve bright colors only for active connections, real-time transmissions, or alarms.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Make the UI dense, sharp, and highly functional.
Create depth using subtle 1px borders and varying shades of dark gray (#09090B to #1A1A1D) instead of heavy shadows.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) in the UI. Use a professional icon library like Lucide React or Phosphor.
Use tabular-nums for all metrics, KPIs, and high-speed data to prevent horizontal jittering.
instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Generate .js files, NOT .tsx files. Follow standard modern React patterns using JavaScript.
Initialize React app with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI primitives.
Install required fonts (Chivo, IBM Plex Mono, Inter) and apply them via Tailwind config.
Implement WebSocket hook/logic for the Runtime Mode high-speed serial communication channel. Build a robust simulation/mock for the OPC UA server and WebSocket feed.
Build 'Configuration Mode' with full CRUD for the Server Manager and a Tag Browser/Selector for defining the source OPC UA servers and tags.
Build 'Runtime Mode' displaying a live streaming dashboard with KPIs, real-time tag sparklines, throughput counters (msgs/sec, bytes/sec).
Build a live feed Serial Channel Monitor displaying serialized frames, allowing toggle between JSON and Binary (MessagePack) formats, and a start/stop transmission button.
